svg.text: A 16 m road crossed by an 8 m one at 30°: every two of its four legs, alone, then all together
far out, where their curbs cross
far out, where their curbs cross
All six together: darker where more of
them cover the ground. Line: their outline
The junction, cut back to the roadways:
four corners, where the curbs cross
Dashed: each leg's centerline, the pair's own in color. Light: a junction. Dark: the roadways,
where they begin in the crossing. Dots: the corners.
